summary: Backend-only testing of Clengo laundry service API. Wrote pytest suite (43 tests) covering pincodes, catalog, auth gating (Emergent session model - tokens seeded via mongosh), orders (create with unique CLG-YYMMDD-XXXXXX ID, ownership isolation, pincode gating), complaints (order ownership check), and admin endpoints (stats, orders + filters, status update, xlsx export, complaints, pincode CRUD). All 43 tests PASS.

minor.issue: Returns 200 on successful create; convention would be 201 Created. Non-blocking.
Also returns 200; 201 would be more RESTful.

created_at is stored as ISO string (not BSON Date). String range comparisons work only because ISO-8601 sorts lexicographically. Fragile if timezone offsets are ever mixed. Consider storing as BSON Date.

Sets cookie with samesite='none' and secure=True — correct for cross-site, but hard-coded. If the frontend is ever served from same origin over http (dev), cookie will be dropped. Not exercised in tests (Emergent OAuth is out of scope), only existence of endpoint verified.

action_items: (Optional) Return 201 on POST /api/orders and POST /api/complaints for RESTful correctness.
(Optional) Store orders.created_at as BSON Date (not ISO string) so date-range filtering is index-friendly and timezone-safe.
(Optional) Add server-side re-validation of item unit_price/subtotal against catalog to prevent tampered totals from the client.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 622 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/orders.py, routers/admin.py, models.py, deps.py once more features are added.

OrderCreate accepts client-supplied unit_price and subtotal without server-side re-computation from the catalog. A malicious client could send subtotal=0. Recommend recomputing prices server-side from the catalog before persisting.
Startup hook uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers; not blocking but will produce deprecation warnings on newer versions.

CORS is configured with allow_credentials=True and allow_origins='*' (default). This is invalid per the CORS spec (browsers will reject credentialed requests when Origin is '*'). Set CORS_ORIGINS to the specific frontend origin in .env for production.

Admin orders `service` filter uses `items.service` equality; if an order has multiple services it will still match, but the returned order includes all items (not just the matching service). Documented / acceptable, but front-end must be aware.
gen_order_id() uses only 6 hex chars = 24 bits of entropy. Collision probability is low at low volumes but a unique index on orders.order_id is recommended to guarantee uniqueness under concurrency.
No pagination on /api/admin/orders (to_list(2000)) or /api/admin/orders/export (to_list(10000)). Fine now, but will need pagination as data grows.
get_current_user does not refresh sliding session expiry — tokens hard-expire in 7 days. Acceptable, just noting.
test_credentials: Sessions are seeded in Mongo by pytest fixture (see /app/backend/tests/conftest.py). Admin email admin@clengo.in is auto-seeded on backend startup with role='admin'.
seed_data_creation: Pytest fixture 'seeded_tokens' inserts 2 regular users + admin session in MongoDB before test session, cleans up regular users after. Backend startup already seeds 12 pincodes, 16 catalog items, and admin user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 43 backend tests pass. To re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. If you add new endpoints, extend TestAdmin/TestOrders/TestComplaints classes. Fixture `seeded_tokens` provides user_token, user2_token, admin_token via `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Emergent OAuth /session-data call is external and is intentionally NOT exercised end-to-end (only the endpoint's existence and bad-request handling is tested).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All specified test cases in the review request pass: 12 pincodes returned, serviceable check works, 16 catalog items returned, /api/auth/me returns 401 without token, full auth-gated flow works via seeded sessions, POST /api/orders generates CLG- unique IDs and rejects unserviceable pincodes, /api/orders/me isolates by user, cross-user GET returns 403, complaints validate ownership, admin gate returns 403 for non-admin, status PATCH validates enum, .xlsx export returns spreadsheet content-type with PK zip signature, admin pincode CRUD upsert+delete works, all filters (search/status/pincode/service/date_from/date_to) on admin/orders work.
